metadata.question: Does the valley fog coverage in the Upper Arrow Lake area decrease from morning to afternoon on October 22, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Upper Arrow Lake area (British Columbia, Canada, approximately 50.5°N, 117.5°W) - Date: October 22, 2018 - Need imagery at two time points: morning and afternoon - Landsat 8 has a single overpass per day (~10:30 AM local), so cannot capture morning vs afternoon - Sentinel-2 also has single overpass times - Need geostationary satellites: GOES-16/17 for North America with frequent temporal resolution - GOES-16/17 can provide hourly or sub-hourly imagery 2. Masking strategy: - This question IS about fog/clouds, so we should NOT mask them out - Need to detect fog coverage, which appears as low clouds in valleys - Can use brightness temperature differences or visible imagery to detect fog - Morning fog typically shows up in visible bands and dissipates by afternoon 3. Logic: - Valid decrease: morning fog > afternoon fog → Answer A - No decrease or increase: morning fog ≤ afternoon fog → Answer B - C1: No images found for morning or afternoon - C2: No valid pixels after processing - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Upper Arrow Lake area (British Columbia, Canada) const upperArrowLake = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.8, 50.3]); const region = upperArrowLake.buffer(20000); // 20km buffer // Define morning (8-10 AM local) and afternoon (2-4 PM local) times // Local time is UTC-7 or UTC-8, using UTC-7 for October // Morning: 15:00-17:00 UTC, Afternoon: 21:00-23:00 UTC const morningStart = ee.Date('2018-10-22T15:00:00'); const morningEnd = ee.Date('2018-10-22T17:00:00'); const afternoonStart = ee.Date('2018-10-22T21:00:00'); const afternoonEnd = ee.Date('2018-10-22T23:00:00'); // Try GOES-16 (East) - Band 2 (Red visible, 0.64 μm) for fog detection let morningCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/GOES/16/MCMIPC') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(morningStart, morningEnd) .select('CMI_C02'); let afternoonCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/GOES/16/MCMIPC') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(afternoonStart, afternoonEnd) .select('CMI_C02'); const mornSize = await morningCol.size().getInfo(); const aftSize = await afternoonCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Morning images: ${mornSize}, Afternoon images: ${aftSize}`); if (mornSize === 0 || aftSize === 0) { // Try GOES-17 (West) which better covers this area morningCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/GOES/17/MCMIPF') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(morningStart, morningEnd) .select('CMI_C02'); afternoonCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/GOES/17/MCMIPF') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(afternoonStart, afternoonEnd) .select('CMI_C02'); const mornSize2 = await morningCol.size().getInfo(); const aftSize2 = await afternoonCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`GOES-17 Morning images: ${mornSize2}, Afternoon images: ${aftSize2}`); if (mornSize2 === 0 || aftSize2 === 0) { console.log("No GOES data available for specified times"); console.log("C1"); return; } } // Get median composite for each time period const morningImg = morningCol.median(); const afternoonImg = afternoonCol.median(); // Low reflectance in visible band indicates fog/low clouds // Fog typically has reflectance < 0.3-0.4 const fogThreshold = 0.35; const morningFog = morningImg.lt(fogThreshold); const afternoonFog = afternoonImg.lt(fogThreshold); // Calculate fog coverage area const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea(); const morningStats = await morningFog.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 2000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const afternoonStats = await afternoonFog.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 2000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const morningCount = await morningFog.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 2000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const morningArea = morningStats.CMI_C02; const afternoonArea = afternoonStats.CMI_C02; const totalPixels = morningCount.CMI_C02; console.log(`Total pixels analyzed: ${totalPixels}`); if (totalPixels === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels in region"); console.log("C2"); return; } if (morningArea === null || morningArea === undefined || afternoonArea === null || afternoonArea === undefined) { console.log("Calculation failed - null values"); console.log("C3"); return; } const morningAreaKm2 = morningArea / 1e6; const afternoonAreaKm2 = afternoonArea / 1e6; console.log(`Morning fog area: ${morningAreaKm2.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`Afternoon fog area: ${afternoonAreaKm2.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`Change: ${(morningAreaKm2 - afternoonAreaKm2).toFixed(2)} km²`); if (morningAreaKm2 > afternoonAreaKm2) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
